verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms card creation via Core API and sandbox simulation of transactions, plus velocity/authorization controls, but none of the citations explicitly document activate, pause/unpause, report lost/stolen, reissue-linked-to-original, or permanent close endpoints. Missing for 10: explicit docs on card state-transition endpoints (activate/suspend/unsuspend), lost/stolen reporting, reissue linkage, and card termination/closure.
